scope: Analytic section depth at the reported sampled mesh extrema on each clock. Interval coverage is separate.

measurements.basis: Preliminary geometric assumptions authorized for this review. The belt limit is a rounded 8 mm one-sided indentation, roughly 16% of the 50.8 mm unloaded NOTE section diameter. Separate planning limits apply to the named treads, soft pad and guiding surfaces. No measured allowable or contact force is claimed.
